source_roi_and_clock: All 11 selected author ROI videos; raw xy/clip pixel-per-metre ratio. Primary axes +x right/+y down as provided for image coordinates. Nominal t0-centered 0.1-second network and native nearest PTS to score actual original video frames. 0,90,180,270 deg rotate observed input displacements CCW algebraically, undo rotation on prediction. Original clock and crop axis stay fixed. No best-angle choice.
estimand: M0 minus measured-time last-pair CV ADE, at native 0 degrees across every enrolled window; also report nominal-step CV and FDE. Four original PINNS M0 seed42 fold weights; use highest-probability mode of six for each checkpoint. Equal checkpoint errors then equal windows. Also equal local people and equal clips, each public clip, and timing supports. One source site. No pose-like proxy for M0, use project M0 unimodal encoder as implemented, hard zero pose with all five measured position masks. Source static type is absent: use final observed nominal-step speed <0.20 m/s. No fitting or local external predictions.
detector: Torchvision FasterRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_V2 official COCO_V1 checkpoint fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn_v2_coco-dd69338a.pth and fixed standard inference settings. Original RGB only, person class 1, score >=0.50. For each already-selected historical image, cover all pixels by fixed <=384-square tiles (96 px overlap), including last boundary-aligned tile, unpadded except Torchvision internal resizing. Translate boxes and globally deduplicate with score-descending, coordinate tie-break, IoU NMS 0.5. No weights, detection threshold or matching choice selected by external scores.
association: For each source t and ID, project supplied tracked ROI point. For every candidate detection, collect ALL same-frame annotated pedestrian IDs whose original point is inside its continuous closed xyxy box. A reliable link requires exactly one source ID in the box and exactly one surviving person detection containing that ID. A box with two annotations or an ID contained in two boxes is ambiguous; assign missing. Predictions do not see future frame membership, pre-label-based movement or future crops. Quantify missing, ambiguous/multiple/both, and explicitly reject box-at-point heuristics.
pose: Apply frozen official RTMPose to uniquely associated original photo crop. Preserve all 3,066 M1 windows with zeros for missing poses + zero bbox / quality through original tensors; report 0..5 matched histories, 5/5 and 0/5 subsets, as well as threshold-crossing and confidence summaries. Missing history geometry is never fabricated. Compare frozen M1/M0 on original axes and same registered windows. If no five-of-five linked sample, state that high-quality pose contrast is unsupported, continue to give all-window fallback. Fixed legacy quality_gate with unavailable poses follows its implementation; does not guarantee matching separately trained M0 weights.
audit: Coverage first, independent of forecasts: on all 1,656 distinct required historical images or predeclared low-cost pilot (first pre-enrolled window from each of 11 clips sorted actor then t0), validate screenshot coordinates at actual dimensions. Pilot is only a feasibility check with 11 windows, not full-cohort attrition; full job must preserve all 3066. When full run feasible, publish aggregate only. No use of background derived with future frames.
